item.title: The Gospel According to Bitcoin: Jordan Bush & Daniel Sherman [Dead Men Walking Podcast]
item.description:
Send us a text

Happy New Year! This week Greg sat down with Jordan Bush & Daniel Sherman. They are the authors of "The Gospel According to Bitcoin". They discussed how the principles of bitcoin align with the principles of the bible and the character of God. They gave a few examples from the book, and they also discussed what crypto will look like under the Trump administration, as well as the near future. Enjoy!

item.title: President of New Saint Andrews College Ben Merkle [Dead Men Walking Podcast]
item.description:
Send us a text

On this special Christmas episode, this week Greg welcomed back to the show Ben Merkle. Ben is the President of New Saint Andrews College. They discussed the national platform that they have been thrust into with Trump Nominee Pete Hegseth speaking about them recently. (Secretary of Defense) They also talked about how employers are moving away from finding talent at larger liberal universities and instead focusing on recruiting at smaller conservative colleges and universities. It's always a fun and informative episode when we can sit down with Ben. Enjoy!

item.title: William Wolfe: Grading each Trump Nominee [Dead Men Walking Podcast]
item.description:
Send us a text

This week sat down with William Wolfe. William served as a Senior Official in the Trump Administration both as a Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense at the Pentagon and as Director of Legislative Affairs at the Department of State. He is also the Founder and Executive Director of the Center for Baptist Leadership. 

Greg and William went through and discussed the following Trump Nominees:

FBI Director: Kash Patel

White House chief of staff: Susie Wiles

Secretary of State: Marco Rubio

Attorney general: Pam Bondi (after Matt Gaetz withdrew)

HHS secretary: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.

"Border czar": Tom Homan

Defense secretary: Pete Hegseth

Secretary of homeland security: Kristi Noem

Director of national intelligence: Tulsi Gabbard

Department of Government Efficiency: Elon Musk and Vivek Ramaswamy
